picks.comment: The featured pick: Mark's stacked RB room carries the day, Mick's horseshoe finally falls out, and Mels-16 wins by 50.

Two one-time champions face off. Chris pulls this one out behind a bounce-back game from Ja’Marr Chase. I think KC leans less on the run against Indy this week, giving Rashee Rice his chance to shine.
Another battle of champions. This time, the defending champ takes the L thanks to a lack of firepower at running back. Mark's team is a little too well balanced here. I'm taking Mark.

With a question mark around Zay Flowers' availability and a pretty weak RB2 spot, I don't think Brett can sustain the firepower he showed in Week 1. Jason takes this one—even with Fairbairn finishing as his third-highest scorer this week.
Dillon is leaning a little too hard on an offense going up against Houston this week. Grim Reaper takes the W in what I'm calling the lowest-scoring matchup of the week.
This might be the closest matchup on paper. I'm taking the Dallas stack, but it'll take a big effort from Jonathan Taylor on Sunday night to push Slim Pickens past Dusty.
